assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production-ready game pet sprite atlas, landscape 1536x1024, transparent background. Create a precise 3-column by 2-row equal-cell grid across the entire canvas. Each cell square; no gaps, frames, labels, text or watermark. Five collectible pet sprites for a dark cyberpunk incremental game, adorable polished toy-like 3D chibi creature renders, readable friendly expressive eyes, soft rim lighting, complete body, front three-quarter view, consistent camera and scale. Order strictly: row 1 cells left-to-right first three pets; row 2 left-to-right fourth and fifth pets; bottom right sixth cell completely empty transparent. Each creature centered exactly within its cell and contained in the central 75% of that cell, generous transparent padding, no part crosses into another cell. Subjects in order: Ash Mouse: tiny gray mouse with warm ember cheeks; Camp Cat: orange camp cat with cyan collar; Ember Fox: orange fox with luminous ember tail; Flame Owl: round owl with red-gold flame feather tips; Phoenix: small brilliant orange-red phoenix. Constraints: true transparent alpha, isolated characters only, no background floor, no shadows extending out of cells, no extra characters, original designs.
